property_summary: For every caller address A and any amount/value/target/data, calling withdrawAll either (on the reference) only succeeds when msg.sender == owner; in particular, if a non-owner calls withdrawAll and the external call from withdrawAll reverts (causing no Ether to be sent), the reference will revert for any non-owner but the mutant (which allows address(0) as an allowed caller) can succeed when msg.sender == address(0); therefore: for any caller A and adversarial recipient that reverts on receiving funds, if the call to withdrawAll returns (ok==true) then A must equal owner (the mutant allows ok==true when A==address(0) breaking this).
change_summary: Weaken the onlyOwner modifier check to require msg.sender == owner || msg.sender == address(0), allowing address(0) to call withdrawAll which changes revert behavior.
